verdict.rationale: Spline ships an official developer surface: the Code API, built on the Spline Runtime npm package, lets developers trigger actions and modify scene objects from their own code, and scenes export as Vanilla JS, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber code. However, it is a single JavaScript scene-runtime library. The evidence states there is no REST API, no machine-readable spec and no hosted reference, so the SDK coverage is narrow. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond the web JS runtime (other languages, platform/editor API), hosted SDK reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Code API is a set of tools for developers to add custom interactivity between Spline scenes and their custom code
It enables you to trigger actions, modify object properties, and create dynamic, responsive 3D environments directly from your existing code and user interface.
Spline allows you to export the code of your scene as: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber
